blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY, Philippines — The Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) has estimated that up to P900,000 in properties were damaged in a fire that gutted an eight-door apartment and an adjacent house in Barangay Pala-o here early Thursday, Nov. 5, killing two women. FO2 Ruel Pairat, arson investigator of BFP-Iligan, said the estimate followed a post-blaze assessment they did at the site. Pairat said the fatalities were trapped inside one of the apartment units. He identified them as Fatima Ramla Monteron, 26, and Cyzra Jean Nasin, 20. Their remains were immediately transported to Tawi-Tawi for burial in accordance with their families’ customs.
